title: OpenMeter adds usage metering and billing to Kong's platform
summary: The acquisition broadens Kong's monetization layer for API and AI workloads. It improves strategic breadth, while integration quality and financial contribution remain unproven.
confirmed: Kong acquired OpenMeter and described native usage metering and billing as part of the expanded platform.
uncertain: Purchase terms, integration economics, customer uptake, and incremental ARR were not disclosed.
